text:
GPT-5.6 just shipped — and it's not one model anymore.

What changed: OpenAI split it into three tiers, Sol, Terra, and Luna, instead of one default model.

Builder value: you stop overpaying for reasoning you don't need, and stop underpowering the job that actually matters.

Try this: run one throwaway task on Luna and one hard task on Sol this week. Feel the difference in the output, not the marketing.

The signal: intelligence is tiered now. Choosing the right tier is the skill — not defaulting to the biggest model every time.
